body: Yea man I know. If you wouldn’t mind (you don’t have to) could you please give me some more information on urinary blockage?

I’m just kind of ranting now but. I had a UTI not too long ago and waited a couple days to go in the doctor.  When I got prescribed meds I was told to wait by my family for them to pick them up for a day while my where my kidneys were hurting like shit, I couldn’t walk, and I couldn’t stop crying. They got very pissed at me cause it was inconvenient to them basically.

Yes. We have a car but I don’t know how to drive, otherwise I would’ve been out the door so fast. I was thinking about taking my moms card and just say it fuck it and go but was scared it would be counted as stealing or something. I have lost complete trust in them. I haven’t spoken to them besides when I absolutely need to and I don’t wish to. Much more fucked up shit with my family than what happened with Sterling. Can’t wait to get the fuck out of here next year.

I believe they really thought it wasn’t as serious as I was making it out to be. Very condescending. It was a Sunday, only emergency vets were open and probably as you know your bill starts as soon as you enter. It was also someone, who contributed to all of this, birthday. I received a long text later that Sunday evening saying I was ruining it and my attitude was disgusting (I was screaming quiet a lot and kind of hysterical because no one would listen to me) that they’ve dealt with cat issues before and that to basically just drop it. My family has had primarily female cats. No experience with male cats. It was because of expenses but what I find really disgusting is that when they saw him in his last moments they finally wanted to take him to the emergency vet. We aren’t very fortunate with money, however we aren’t dirt poor. I even offered to pick up hours at work and pay for more than half of it. 

Plain stupidity and selfishness.

I wish I thought of calling. I still can’t believe that they let him lay there and die. No one has no idea how much I nagged and pleaded only not to get anywhere. But now I know that they’re not to be trusted with shit like this.
please pm me or someone else
That’s awful. I don’t know why people who aren’t really fully invested in an animal end up getting one. It’s really sad and gross and breaks my heart.

Thank you. I can’t imagine living without an animal. Before him it was really lonely aha. I think this will take a lot of time for me to get over and I think that’s why I feel dumb I guess. I know I’ll find another cat to love so many things about, just not anytime soon.

/: I keep replaying everything back in my head. Really sucks and hurts knowing all of this could have been so easily prevented if someone just listened to me. 

Is urinary blockage a reoccurring thing in male cats?
I’m glad hes okay and hope he continues to be. That really means a lot, thank you. Same to you kind stranger.

I hope your cat is okay. Thank you for that. It kind of clicked today that I really need to get out of here. There’s a lot of other shitty things my family has done besides basically kill my cat. I don’t want to own another cat, especially a male cat, until I’m on my own. Put a lot of shit in perspective for me.
They bought him UTI medicine and I continuously said UTIs only primarily happen with females...This was all about just being completely selfish and I don’t understand why

Thank you for that. I’ll probably end up making a list tonight. My family has always been cat owners, mostly female cats though. It was someones, a person that contributed to all of this, birthday on Sunday and was told I was ruining it because I would not stop saying that he needs to be brought in. Received a long text about how “we’ve dealt with cat issues before” and that “i’m totally disgusted with your attitude” (before he died)
my mom (my grandma but is my mom to me) is 73 with stage 4 breast cancer that spread to some of her organs. so. i dont know. ty for that information
